summary: Searches the constraint element array (this+0x15C8, count at this+0x15C4) for an element whose body-pair identifiers match either ordering of this+0x15F0 and this+0x141C. On match, accumulates the incoming delta a2 into the constraint output vector, applies a matrix-vector transform against the body rotation matrix (this+0x15F0), then calls RelativeVelocityCompute and sub_56D2D0 on the element. Part of the per-frame constraint force solving system dispatched by SolverDispatch (0x0043B930).

operations.description: Read constraint element count from this+0x15C4 and loop only while it is positive.
Iterate the constraint element array starting at this+0x15C8, advancing one element per step (18 DWORD stride per element).
Match element body identifiers against this+0x15F0 (as a body id) and this+0x141C in either order: element[1]==this+0x15F0 && element[3]==this+0x141C, or the swapped pairing.
Both constraint pointers (element[2] and element[4]) must be non-null before computing forces.
Accumulate incoming delta a2 plus this+0x1420 into the first element of the constraint output vector (element+0x10).
Read the body rotation matrix base from this+0x15F0 and scale the accumulated delta by the matrix element at relative offset 0x34.
Compute constraint force component at element+0x20 as scaled delta plus matrix[0x4C]*output[2] plus output[0]*matrix[0x1C].
Compute constraint force component at element+0x28 from matrix[0x3C]*output[1], matrix[0x24]*output[0], and matrix[0x54]*output[2].
Compute constraint force component at element+0x30 from matrix[0x44]*output[1], matrix[0x2C]*output[0], and matrix[0x5C]*output[2].
Compute relative velocity for the matched constraint element via RelativeVelocityCompute.
Run the constraint resolution step sub_56D2D0 on the matched element, then return.
Return after the matched element is solved; if no element matched, fall out of the loop without returning a value.

clean_pseudocode: out[0x20] = s + m[0x4C] * out[0x18] + out[0x8] * m[0x1C];
